body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> LG Electronics presented its 10.6-inch HSDPA notebook pc ''A1''. It means that users can have access to the internet wherever they can use their mobile phone. It features Intel Core Duo ULV processor, 10.6-inch (1280x768) display, and 80GB HDD. It measures 271x195x25.5mm at 1kg.
